name: 生命起源
author: 冥古宙
core: 从无机小分子到自我复制的生物大分子，再到被膜包裹的原细胞；海底热液口与原始汤是两大候选场景。
coreEn: From inorganic molecules to self-replicating polymers and membrane-bound protocells; hydrothermal vents and the primordial soup are leading scenarios.
influence: 生命从此开启，后续所有演化都建立在这第一步之上。
influenceEn: Life began; every later transition builds on this first step.

name: 光合作用起源
author: 太古宙
core: 蓝菌等原核生物学会利用光能把水分解并固碳，逐渐释放氧气，最终引发大氧化事件。
coreEn: Cyanobacteria learned to split water and fix carbon using light, slowly releasing oxygen and triggering the Great Oxidation Event.
influence: 改写了大气成分，既灭绝了厌氧菌，也为复杂需氧生命铺路。
influenceEn: Reshaped the atmosphere—wiped out anaerobes yet enabled complex aerobic life.

name: 真核细胞起源
author: 元古宙
core: 通过内共生，一个原核细胞吞入并保留了能进行呼吸与光合的细菌，分别演化为线粒体与叶绿体。
coreEn: By endosymbiosis, a prokaryote engulfed and retained bacteria that became mitochondria and chloroplasts.
influence: 真核结构让大型、多细胞、分工复杂的生命成为可能。
influenceEn: Eukaryotic architecture enabled large, multicellular, specialized life.

name: 多细胞化
author: 元古宙
core: 细胞之间出现分工与连接（如细胞黏附、信号传导），单细胞集群演化为真正多细胞的个体。
coreEn: Cells gained division of labor and adhesion (cell junctions, signaling), turning loose colonies into true multicellular individuals.
influence: 体型的增大与器官的形成都以此为前提。
influenceEn: Precondition for larger bodies and organs.

name: 寒武纪大爆发
author: 显生宙 · 寒武纪
core: 在相对短暂的地质窗口里，绝大多数动物门类迅速出现，并演化出硬骨骼、眼睛与捕食—被捕食的军备竞赛。
coreEn: In a geologically brief window most animal phyla appeared, evolving hard skeletons, eyes and predator–prey arms races.
influence: 奠定了此后动物界的基本蓝图，现代生态的雏形在此定型。
influenceEn: Set the blueprint for the animal kingdom and modern ecosystems.

name: 植物登陆
author: 显生宙 · 奥陶—志留纪
core: 绿藻近缘的类群演化出角质层、维管束与孢子，从水域走上陆地，开始改变土壤与大气。
coreEn: Algal relatives evolved cuticle, vascular tissue and spores, stepping onto land and altering soils and air.
influence: 陆地生态与后续动物登陆的基础，也显著增强了风化与碳循环。
influenceEn: Foundation for terrestrial ecosystems and later animal landfall; boosted weathering and carbon cycling.

name: 动物登陆
author: 显生宙 · 泥盆纪
core: 肉鳍鱼类的胸鳍演化为四肢，肺与皮肤适应空气呼吸，四足动物由此登上陆地。
coreEn: Lobefin fish turned fins into limbs and lungs adapted to air; tetrapods stepped ashore.
influence: 脊椎动物从此占据陆地，最终演化出爬行动物、恐龙与哺乳动物。
influenceEn: Vertebrates colonized land, leading to reptiles, dinosaurs and mammals.

name: 二叠纪大灭绝
author: 显生宙 · 二叠纪末
core: 由大规模火山活动与海洋缺氧引发，约 95% 的海洋物种与七成陆地脊椎动物消失，是地球史上最严重的灭绝。
coreEn: Driven by massive volcanism and ocean anoxia, ~95% of marine species and 70% of land vertebrates vanished—Earth's worst extinction.
influence: 清空生态位，为恐龙在三叠—侏罗纪的崛起腾出空间。
influenceEn: Cleared niches, opening the way for dinosaur dominance in the Triassic–Jurassic.

name: 恐龙时代
author: 显生宙 · 三叠—白垩纪
core: 恐龙成为陆地优势脊椎动物，演化出巨大体型、羽毛与可能的温血代谢，并分化出鸟类这一现生支系。
coreEn: Dinosaurs dominated land vertebrates, evolving huge size, feathers and likely endothermy, with birds as their surviving branch.
influence: 定义了中生代生态，鸟类的延续让恐龙以另一种形式存活至今。
influenceEn: Defined Mesozoic ecology; birds let dinosaurs survive to today.

name: 白垩纪—古近纪灭绝
author: 显生宙 · 白垩纪末
core: 小行星撞击（墨西哥尤卡坦）叠加火山活动，导致非鸟恐龙与大量物种灭绝，被子植物与哺乳动物迎来机会。
coreEn: An asteroid impact (Yucatán) plus volcanism killed non-avian dinosaurs and many species, opening doors for angiosperms and mammals.
influence: 终结中生代，开启新生代，哺乳动物由此走上中心舞台。
influenceEn: Ended the Mesozoic, opened the Cenozoic; mammals took center stage.

name: 哺乳动物辐射
author: 显生宙 · 古近纪
core: 恐龙消失后，哺乳动物迅速占据空缺生态位，胎盘类尤其繁盛，体型与多样性快速扩张。
coreEn: After dinosaurs vanished, mammals rapidly filled empty niches; placentals especially diversified in size and form.
influence: 铺垫了包括灵长类与人类在内的后续演化主线。
influenceEn: Set the stage for primates and ultimately humans.

name: 人类起源
author: 显生宙 · 新近—第四纪
core: 人猿在约 700 万年前分化，随后出现直立行走、工具制造、语言与火的利用，最终智人扩散至全球。
coreEn: Hominins split from apes ≈7 Ma, then evolved bipedalism, tool use, language and fire, with Homo sapiens spreading worldwide.
influence: 人类成为首个能系统性改造生物圈与气候的物种。
influenceEn: Humans became the first species to systematically reshape the biosphere and climate.

name: 大氧化事件
author: 太古宙—元古宙
core: 蓝细菌光合作用释放的氧气在海与大气中急剧累积，永久改变了地球化学与生命演化方向。
coreEn: Oxygen from cyanobacterial photosynthesis flooded the oceans and air, permanently reshaping Earth's chemistry and the course of life.
influence: 为需氧代谢与大型复杂生命铺路，却也造成厌氧生物的大规模衰退，是地球最早的生态革命。
influenceEn: Paved the way for aerobic metabolism and complex life, while crashing anaerobic biospheres — Earth's first ecological revolution.

name: 被子植物辐射
author: 白垩纪
core: 开花植物迅速崛起并主导陆地植被，与传粉动物协同演化，重塑了整个陆地生态系统。
coreEn: Flowering plants rose swiftly to dominate land vegetation, co-evolving with pollinators and remaking terrestrial ecosystems.
influence: 为昆虫、鸟类与哺乳动物提供新生态位与食物基础，奠定了现代景观与人类农业的底色。
influenceEn: Created niches and food for insects, birds and mammals, setting the canvas of modern landscapes and of human agriculture.

name: 恐龙演化为鸟类
author: 侏罗纪—白垩纪
core: 鸟类是从兽脚类恐龙演化而来的一支，始祖鸟与带羽恐龙揭示了两类群之间的连续过渡。
coreEn: Birds are living theropod dinosaurs; Archaeopteryx and feathered dinosaurs reveal the continuous transition between the two.
influence: 把恐龙与鸟联结为同一演化谱系，成为演化论最生动的例证之一，也让恐龙以鸟类之形延续至今。
influenceEn: Binds dinosaurs and birds into one lineage — a vivid proof of evolution — letting dinosaurs survive today as birds.
